shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "ls -la .lore; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; git status -sb; rg -n 'beforeSession|afterSession|onError' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; rg --files | rg 'chatOrchestrator.*test|tdd-loop|AGENTS.md|spec-links/reanchor'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; cat package.json; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs'

/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '70,170p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; rg -n 'specs/.+#[0-9]+' src | head; head -35 CHANGELOG.md; ls node_modules/.bin/jest node_modules/.bin/prettier; command -v timeout"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace('      if (hooks?.beforeSession) await hooks.beforeSession(session);\\n\\n      try {','      try {\\n        if (hooks?.beforeSession) await hooks.beforeSession(session);')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Move "'`beforeSession` inside'"','- [x] Move "'`beforeSession` inside'"'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='CHANGELOG.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('### Changed\\n','### Changed\\n\\n- When "'`beforeSession` throws, `onError` and `afterSession` now run before the error reaches the caller. Cleanup hooks must handle a turn that stopped before provider interaction.'"\\n',1); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('([validated by: runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#L40)).','([validated by: runs onError and afterSession when beforeSession throws](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts#L40); [validated by: specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#10 calls onError with the session and beforeSession error](../../src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts#L7)).'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.+#|spec:' scripts/lore* src/orchestration | head -30; git diff; git status -sb"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.lore/dod.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Document in the CHANGELOG','- [x] Document in the CHANGELOG'); open(p,'w').write(s)
p='specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'; s=open(p).read().replace('chatOrchestrator.ts#L150','chatOrchestrator.ts#L149').replace('chatOrchestrator.ts#L148','chatOrchestrator.ts#L147'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts && git commit -m 'fix(orchestrator): handle session setup errors' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
